reviews.title: Way too sensitive to touch
reviews.text: While I like the new changes, including adding .25 and .5 stars, I keep accidentally clicking on the stars while I’m scrolling and rating books I’ve never read. The new app is way too sensitive and it’s super annoying. Other app users in my life have also mentioned the same thing.

reviews.title: Fix accidental rating issue
reviews.text: You can’t scroll without rating and adding books now. Even if you clear rating it adds books to read. It’s so annoying and i dont get to scroll my friends feeds anymore

reviews.title: Worked fine, now it doesn’t.
reviews.text: One night I logged in and the app said there was a server problem. Tried again to log in but the app or website won’t accept my password, and it hasn’t been compromised because I’d know if it had. It keeps saying password not correct, so I try to get Goodreads to send me an email to change my password. Nothing happens. I check spam folder as well. Nothing. Now I can’t get back into my account to track my reading progress. Reinstalling the app doesn’t work either.

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: it logged me out for no reason and no matter how much i try to log back in with the forget password it doesn’t work it’s just a loop and now all my read books are gone and i can’t even make a new account because i already have an account with that email and it won’t let me log in

reviews.title: New UX sucks, too many ads
reviews.text: Amazon finally got around to ruining the best book app.

reviews.title: Can’t add to currently reading
reviews.text:
Edit: can’t add anything to currently reading with the mobile app. The stars get accidentally selected when scrolling. quality of life updates, please!!!! And my below message still stands, Oprah sucks. 

Why is Oprah a challenge. Get her out of here. We’re not doing a challenge for every book club, and she is the last person you should be supporting right now. Oh wait, you’re supported by Amazon. No wonder.

reviews.title: Choose a Different Book Tracker!
reviews.text: Terrible app. If I hadn’t already put all my books in, then I would never use it again. How is the most popular book app so laggy, unreliable, and unintuitive? The more I use this app the more I loath it.

reviews.title: Constant error
reviews.text: I can’t even use the app it keeps giving me an error message

reviews.title: STOP ALLOWING RATINGS FOR UNPUBLISHED BOOKS
reviews.text:
For the love of God, STOP allowing people to rate/review books which are not published. It completely undermines the authenticity of ratings across the whole app. 

I am looking at a book with 1000+ ratings and a 4.56 average which is not out for another YEAR. Even early reviewers won’t have a copy yet, so why is this allowed?!

I will die on this hill.

reviews.title: Importing data
reviews.text: I need to import my data to my Bookward app and Bookward only takes CSV files the Goodreads app doesn't offer it as a CSV file

reviews.title: Bug masked as features?
reviews.text: Tried raising this with the app devs already, but my bug report and feedback keeps being ignored - Scrolling the main feed in the app makes it far too easy to accidentally tap and alter existing ratings or rate suggested books by mistake. Because these inputs auto-save instantly without a confirmation prompt or revision history, phantom taps quietly overwrite past scores and create incorrect records, turning standard feed browsing into a risky, high-friction user experience.

reviews.title: New format
reviews.text: I don’t like the new format, when I’m scrolling recommendations my finger often hits a rating buttons. If I catch it I can fix it but I’ve missed some.

reviews.title: Amazon 🙄
reviews.text: We all know Amazon bought Goodreads ages ago, but with this latest update you really feel it. Why am I getting ads for diaper pails while I’m trying to read reviews? Looking for a new way to record my books now.

reviews.title: Over run with Ads now
reviews.text: The app is starting to be over run with ads and it’s highly annoying. I’m ready to give up using app trackers at this point because I am so tired of ads being shoved down my throat. You are owned by Amazon you don’t need ad revenue you are just being greedy and annoying.

reviews.title: Outdated
reviews.text: Honestly this app is so outdated. I only use it because my friends do. It’s 2026 can we make it easier to use, more tech savvy, and more idk fun? Like why is it so dull, why is there not a lot of cute cool features like other book apps? I would use other apps if I knew others who did. Mostly why I’m only using this one. Come on guys, it’s not hard

reviews.title: Good app but forced me to review
reviews.text: Good app but forced me to review

reviews.title: hated update
reviews.text: why would you go and ruin something beautiful? revert.

reviews.title: Stop asking me to submit a review.
reviews.text: Every time I finish a book the app asks me to make a review so here you go. Stop asking!!! It’s annoying, the app is getting used well. You’re fulling your purpose. Be happy and leave us alone.

reviews.title: No customer support
reviews.text: I had to login to my account. Was prompted to reset my password with a one time code. Never received the code. Tried this a dozen times in different ways. Tried requesting help but only get automated responses. Now I can’t access my lists. It’s a fine app but with no customer support it’s worthless.

reviews.title: Useless recommendations
reviews.text: The recommendations on the Amin page are just bad, badly updated, badly fit. The “similar books” on a book page are mediocre and uninsightful. If you don’t know what to read next and you’re already aware of the mainstream books in the genre, it won’t be very helpful for you.

reviews.title: Doesn’t function like it should
reviews.text: I think it’s ridiculous that Goodreads has existed for so long and I still can’t see what my friends are reading or reviewing. The suggested fixes for this problem are not having too many friends as top friends. Well I’m only friends with 8 people so what am I supposed to do about that. But thank goodness I can see all the advertisements, what ever would I do without my advertisements! It’s crazy that for every activity a friend has logged I have to sift through 3-5+ trending books (that I don’t care about, respectfully) or giant ads. Also the fact that you can’t change your feed layout on mobile and have to go to desktop is so dumb.

reviews.title: updates tanked the UI
reviews.text: Yes, the ability to give half stars is awesome. Unfortunately, that is completely canceled out by the much bigger and more frequent ads, and especially the constant accidental ratings. I don't need to be able to rate books directly from my feed! When would I ever need to do that? If that gets fixed and the ads go back to normal in a future update, I would for sure update to five stars.

reviews.title: Would give it .25 but App Store doesn’t do its rating system
reviews.text: The quarter or half star rating system is worthless. Make people commit to what they felt about a book instead of making it out of 10, oh wait is it actually out of 20??? Bad decision.

reviews.title: No iPhone Duo support
reviews.text: Update your app

reviews.title: needs updating
reviews.text:
goodreads could be such an amazing platform! we need a better algorithm that shows more books and a diversity of them - things that are being read now amongst readers everywhere, within your age group, within a genre, or within the last ten years etc, things my friends on the app are reading. we do get lists every so often, but they’re often redundant or have titles that have gone viral. if you look up horror titles on goodreads, it gives you the same classics over and over. there’s tons of books being written and talked about, but i only ever hear about them from my friend’s reviews and profiles.

the fact that we can’t respond to comments on the mobile app in 2026 is crazy. that’s a huge way to boost engagement. every time i want to reply to a comment, i have to either open my laptop or open safari and go to browser mode.

reviews.title: App Won’t Open
reviews.text: Used to work just fine, since the update it just has a blank screen every time I try to use it. Have tried deleting and redownloading multiple times, nothing seems to fix it.

reviews.title: Fair
reviews.text: Too many crashes despite the app updates. It crashes at the wrong time. Otherwise a good app

reviews.title: No customer service and locked out
reviews.text: Used GoodReads for over a decade to track my books and get recommendations. Out of the blue, GoodReads signs me out and says I need a new password and sends a link to a prior email address that no longer exists. No way to contact customer service, their rudimentary BOT sends me not relevant suggestions. No way to contact a live person. Lost a decade worth of ratings and reviews.

reviews.title: Loved this app until…
reviews.text: I can no longer view my books or shelves. I hope they fix this soon. Until then, 2 stars.

reviews.title: The new ad placements in book lists are AWFUL
reviews.text:
The way the app now displays large ads everywhere in our book lists has absolutely ruined the app! I’ve loved having this app for years and being able to seamlessly scroll through the books I’ve read. The app now makes that impossible because literally every 3-4 books in a list is met with another ugly ad in the middle of it.

I don’t care if the app has ads but this placement within lists is horrible. Please change this.

reviews.title: I dont like the new rate this book features
reviews.text: It makes me accidentally rate many books while surfing and it’s really annoying

reviews.title: Bad UX, getting worse
reviews.text: Goodreads is an ok app. It’s fun to see what other people are doing and read about their experiences reading. That’s just about the only reason I still use it. The UX is horrible and has been for a while—it’s a very janky app which often displays incorrect data. Now, they’ve made it all the more easy to accidentally rate a book, which is even more frustrating. I know apps constantly go through a cycle of “innovation” that is actually making the UX worse, but frustrating to see Goodreads do the same

reviews.title: Ads in my book lists 0/5 stars
reviews.text: All of a sudden there are now ads in my lists of books. Every 5 books there is a massive ad you have to scroll by. Completely ruins the experience of this app. Use a different one.

reviews.title: Huge ugly adds
reviews.text: There are now pop up adds in my list of books I’ve read. Huge and frequent. The whole point is to easily keep track of what I read and these adds are making it unpleasant to look through them. Ruined experience.

reviews.title: Not letting me rate or review
reviews.text: Goodreads is not letting me rate or review books. This is so annoying

reviews.title: Accidentally Rating While Scrolling
reviews.text: New version’s interface is legitimately bad. While scrolling it is way too easy to accidentally rate a book that you have not read / have no interest in reading. Not the end of the world because it asks you to confirm the rating, but the UX is bad having to frequently pause what you’re doing.

reviews.title: Can’t scroll without giving a 5 star rating!
reviews.text: The ‘rate this book’ stars on the posts on homepage etc are too sensitive. Every time I scroll I give another book 5 stars… why would I want to rate books I’ve never read. Very frustrating

reviews.title: I Hate the “want To Read” heading is now white. It’s confusing.
reviews.text: They changed the “want To Read” heading to white after you’ve clicked on it. It makes it hard to easily determine that you’ve already chosen it as a book you want to read. Now it’s confusing and the same color as the “Get The Book” tab which is directly underneath it. It’s white even though you haven’t clicked it which is the opposite. I liked it before when you clicked Want To Read it turned that heading to brown I think. Or whatever it was, it wasn’t confusing. I really hate it and considering going to another app.

reviews.title: User interface testers phoned it in…
reviews.text: I cannot scroll through this app with accidentally rating dozens of books. How this sort of issue gets through user interface testing, I will never understand…I know they’re planning on fixing it. Can’t wait.

reviews.title: From loving to heartbroken
reviews.text: I had this app for many years and have recorded hundreds of books on it. Then today it had me update the app and after updating it said my account had been compromised and it was going to send an email to change my password. The problem with that is since I have had my account for so long that email provider no longer exist. When I contact a customer support, I was given 3 options. Two of them I couldn’t do since I can no longer get into my account and when I tried to log into Goodreads account, I still get the same problem, of it wanting me to change my password on my email. The last option was to make a whole new Goodreads account. There is no way to easily add all the books that I had on my previous account onto a new one. now I will need to make a spreadsheet to hold all of my books so that this problem does not happen again. Unfortunately, what I liked about Goodreads was that I was able to find new books and authors to read in the genres that I liked.

reviews.title: Ratings too limited
reviews.text: It feels like an odd decision to not allow .25 or more so .5 ratings and limit everything to a full star rating and it really kills the app for me. Goodreads has been out for so long but feels outdated and it would be nice to see some updates.

reviews.title: Ok
reviews.text: While this app is the largest in the world for book reviews it could do with a bit of an upgrade. It still looks and feels as if it was first launched in 1997 and it’s very buggy at times.

reviews.title: No dark mode!
reviews.text: It’s 2026 - why is there no dark mode. Overall terrible app

reviews.title: Why is my home feed filled with recommendations?
reviews.text: The home feed provides updates among friends and perhaps a few recommendations in most platform. Why is it that here, there’s a wall of recommendations to ignore before you can actually see updates?

reviews.title: Masters of ensh@@@tion monopoly
reviews.text: Nothing not said before

reviews.title: A shame
reviews.text: Goodreads was great at first and is still a nice place for the social aspect of it all, but little by little they have been whittling away at functionality, and not fixing things that don’t work well, especially on the app, too many things to name in a review like this. Unfortunately, I have good friends on Goodreads and it’s heart wrenching to consider abandoning them all to go somewhere else (which doesn’t really exist yet). But I’m just waiting for Goodreads to close down the groups and then the deal will be sealed.

reviews.title: Probably the worst book tracker
reviews.text: Honestly only use this when I’m starting and finishing a book so I can see the dates. And because most of my friends/family use it. The UI is awful, the lack of a dark mode option is still odd, it looks like it was made in excel. It’s blocky and really awful to look at. If I could persuade everyone to use a different app I would!

reviews.title: Needs updating
reviews.text: It’s a great place to go for book reviews but its being left behind by apps like Fable that really build a community for readers. You can’t do half star reviews and the interface feels very outdated

reviews.title: Has ads in the UK
reviews.text: Poorly designed and dated app. The ads were the icing on the cake.

reviews.title: Can’t Find Books
reviews.text: Far too difficult to find some books. For example I’m searching for a Danielle Steel book and instead of letting me add it I’m taken to a page where I have to scroll through hundreds of books, including foreign language books and noobs containing several of her novels. Really bad. So I can’t add it as I’ve spent ages scrolling and it doesn’t appear

reviews.title: Reading Challenge
reviews.text: Loved good reads until they changed the reading challenge.  I’m not 4 and don’t need special virtual badges.

reviews.title: Good app ruined by excessive focus on prerelease hype
reviews.text: Great if you’re looking for a book to read in three months time. If you’re looking for something to read now, you’re better off going somewhere else like Storygraph

reviews.title: “Please try again”
reviews.text: I am continuously presented with a notification that reads: "An unexpected error occurred. It may be that the Goodreads servers are over capacity: please try again in a bit. You may also try to sign out and sign back in (or force-close and relaunch the app) to refresh your user session." I have executed the recommended actions, including signing out and restarting the application, yet the software remains inoperable. Consequently, the application does not fulfil its intended operational purpose. Total waste of my time

reviews.title: Ads are turning me off
reviews.text: Used to love using this app, but as with other social media and internet platforms, the ads are a real turn-off. I can see my usage dropping drastically like the other social media I used to use. Ensh-ttification truly.

Goodreads books reviews have thousands upon thousands of reviews but the same book on StoryGraph may only have 30? reviews.text: App is okay at best but it logs me out a ridiculous amount of times. Like every single minute (no exaggeration)

reviews.title: Only me?
reviews.text: Am I the only person having trouble with this app? It’s been this way for as long as I can remember. It’s a good app for making a list of books you want and adding what you’re currently reading and what you wanna read. But everything else kinda doesn’t work very well. Especially giveaways. I’ll get an email that a book on my to read list is available for a giveaway. But when I go and tap on it, it opens up a web browser and then disappears, and then opens up the app and it won’t load it. It happens every time. I can’t get one single giveaway email to load in the app cause that’s where it takes me is to a blank screen that won’t load. I wouldn’t mind logging in on a web browser to enter to win the book, but the fact that as soon as I tap on it in my email and it takes me to the web browser, and it disappears and goes to the app that won’t load, I’m always kind of stuck. And literally the app isn’t user-friendly when it comes to finding even giveaways on there in general. I can’t find a tab anywhere that says giveaways. I’d love to peruse books on giveaways that maybe I don’t even know of to enter to win to try them out. But I can’t even find them on the app. So not only does every email with a giveaway book in my to read list not load for me to even enter, I can’t even find a list of giveaways in the app in general. I have a pretty brand new phones, not that old and the fact that it won’t allow this app to load I don’t think it’s the phone. I think it’s the app. I wish you’d f

reviews.title: Lazy Developers
reviews.text: The amount of potential this app has is insane but the developers are clearly lazy and don’t actually care about making it user friendly or visually appealing in any way. The layout is boring and unintuitive. It’s impossible to search by sub-genres or filter by multiple genres. Getting suggestions based on previous books is horribly optimized. The “year in books” doesn’t even have a proper layout or share option. Genuinely the only reason I still use this app is the reviews. Every other book journalling app has way more advanced features but the reviews just aren’t the same. LOCK IN development team and make this app what it should be. I want easy to access reading statistics, I want aesthetically pleasing book shelves. For the love of god add a DNF feature that lets me keep my page progress without keeping it in my currently reading or forcing me to remove it entirely from my library. Give me a new releases page. GIVE US IMPROVEMENTS. Every time an update comes out NOTHING changes!! Even your website is horrible! I could design a better layout on tumblr in 2013. Please please just make some improvements!!
